comparison.objective: Turn a face-down humanoid robot onto its back without trapping or rolling it onto its arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body contact planning, lifting, and controlled rolling of an articulated load.
comparison.success_condition: Robot ends on its back without being rolled onto its own arm; no numeric final-pose or damage thresholds stated.
comparison.reason: Safe manipulation of a large articulated body is meaningfully different from small-scale impact tooling and fragment recovery.
